booking_application.description: Client application type that created the reservation (e.g. web, iphone-appstore, scheduler).

booking_channel.description: Partner integration source for the booking (e.g. mykaarma, xtime, redcap, toyota-oneapp) or dealerware for Dealerware-native bookings.

on_platform.description: Whether the contract allows on-platform payments.

off_platform.description: Whether the contract allows off-platform payments.

enabled.description: Whether the contract dealership supports HopDrive Valet Moves controls.

confirmation_token.description: also referred to as contract id

contactless.description: denotes whether or not the contract is a contactless contract

credit_card_id.description: ID of the credit card selected on the contract, or null when no card is selected.

customer.description: Customer summary. A missing or soft-deleted customer results in a 404 response.

full_name.description: Customer name, masked as Deleted Customer for privacy-deleted customers.

permitted_to_rent.description: Whether the customer is permitted to rent based on the active Do Not Rent list.

daily_rate_override.description: The daily rate to charge for this contract, if different from the default rate for the vehicle

damage_inspections.description: Damage inspection statuses for the active car reservations on this contract.

vehicle_id.description: The vehicle ID for the associated car reservation.

status.description:
The status of the associated damage inspection. Returns `not_inspected`
when no damage inspection exists for that car reservation.

pdf_report_url.description:
The URL for the attached damage inspection PDF report, if present.
Returns `null` when no PDF report has been attached for that car reservation.

external_deposit_amount.description: The amount of the external deposit, if any, that was collected for this contract

starting_fuel_gallons.description: Fuel amount at the start of the contract in gallons

starting_fuel_liters.description: Fuel amount at the start of the contract in liters

ending_fuel_gallons.description: Fuel amount at the end of the contract in gallons

ending_fuel_liters.description: Fuel amount at the end of the contract in liters

starting_fuel_percentage.description: Starting fuel as a percentage of the tank capacity

ending_fuel_percentage.description: Ending fuel as a percentage of the tank capacity

location_sequence.description: sequence id of the contract for its location

starting_odometer_miles.description: Odometer reading at the start of the contract in miles

starting_odometer_km.description: Odometer reading at the start of the contract in kilometers

ending_odometer_miles.description: Odometer reading at the end of the contract in miles

ending_odometer_km.description: Odometer reading at the end of the contract in kilometers

purchase_order.description: The optional purchase order number associated with this contract

repair_order.description: The optional repair order sent from a contract creation request

service_vehicle_id.description: The optional service vehicle ID sent from a contract creation request

service_vehicle_id_valid.description: Whether the service vehicle ID is a valid VIN

signed.description: denotes whether or not the required contract signatures are present

program_minimum_age.description: The applicable minimum age requirement for drivers, including Drive Protection rules when enforced

ineligibility_reasons.description: Detailed information about why drivers may be ineligible for this contract

ineligible_drivers.description: Array of drivers who do not meet the program requirements

customer_id.description: The customer ID (null for additional drivers)

is_primary_driver.description: Whether this is the primary driver

born_on.description: The driver's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

is_contract_eligible.description: Whether the contract is eligible to start based on all eligibility checks

max_vehicle_swaps.description: The maximum number of vehicle swaps that can be performed for this contract.

vehicle_swaps_performed.description: The number of vehicle swaps that have been performed for this contract.
